correctness.rationale: The final result is the length-resolved incidence window, with the RAF transition separately attributed to prior work. Each ordered forward split of a j-letter word contributes one of j−1 reactions, giving R_m=∑(j−1)κ^j. The exponential-geometric sum gives N_m∼κ^(m+1)/(κ−1) and (mN_m−R_m)/N_m=O(1). For a catalyst of weight W, the conditional binomial parameter is 1−exp(−uW/R), R=R_ell, u=R_ell N_n^{−1−β}; 0<u≤nN_n^{−β}→0. The Pareto change of variable v=uW supplies integrand [1−(z+(1−z)exp(−v/R))^R] bounded by min{1,(1−z)v} with density factor αv^{−1−α}. For each v>0 it tends to 1−exp(−(1−z)v). Dominated convergence and integration by parts give the single-catalyst PGF deficit Γ(1−α)(1−z)^αu^α+o(u^α), including zero exactly at z=1. The repaired joint transform for one catalyst is H(0)+w[H(z)−H(0)], with limiting deficit coefficient Γ(1−α)[1−w+w(1−z)^α]. Independence allows raising to N_ell, and N_ell u^{2α}=o(1) uniformly in a bounded-offset window because N_ell u^α=O(1). The counts give N_ell u^α∼ell^α (κ/(κ−1))^(1−αβ) κ^{(1+α)ell−α(1+β)n}; substituting the logarithmic center cancels n^α and gives the stated constant. Validity along all eligible sequences provides uniformity on bounded offsets; compound-Poisson PGF continuity at (1,1) yields subsequential laws, and its marks are positive Sibuya coefficients. At diverging sublinear offsets, use the exact zero-incidence formula H(0)^N_ell and the small-deficit logarithm directly. Separately, the food and reactions of an all-ell RAF match those in the induced model exactly. Its criterion after reparameterization is N_ell N_n^{−α(1+β)}; forward ligations are covered by Kim–Sönmez Theorems 1 and 8. This tends to zero or infinity on the claimed flanks of the separate RAF scale, and to zero at the upper incidence cutoff, where the incidence probability tends to one. Repeated cutoffs can be handled on subsequences of strictly increasing sizes. The frozen script was only inspected; the newly written repairs/4/check.py was replayed with Python 3 and printed 0.8504251761 for its illustrative finite example. No finite check was used as proof of a limit. The model is abstract random words, with no laboratory claims or bounded-offset RAF law.

value.rationale: The rate at which catalytic relations first appear internally is structurally different from the rate at which a closed RAF can first be present. The repaired claim gives a quantitative and distributional benchmark for the former (logarithmic shift, lattice sensitivity, active-catalyst counts and Sibuya bursts), and transparently locates it strictly below the previously implied RAF scale. This is useful even without claiming a new RAF theorem or identifying a finite minimum. It is not a claim about physical chemical onset.
